name: mujoco
families: any MJCF model, such as the MuJoCo Menagerie arms
simulated arms with move_to by inverse kinematics
tests: unit tests on a small built-in arm and the conformance suite, skipped when the mujoco extra isn't installed

estimate.reasoning: The mujoco driver never connects to hardware. It runs any MuJoCo model in real time, so a device file can be tried on a simulated machine before it drives a real one.
